lambda_curve_role: descriptive mechanistic intervention-response curve; primary statistical inference remains lambda=0 vs lambda=1 Nadeau-Bengio corrected repeated-CV test with Holm-12
note: This post-hoc analysis strengthens mechanism characterization and does not replace the frozen primary controlled-intervention evidence.
support_distance_source: saved sample_temporal_risk.csv.gz from each controlled-intervention run
support_score_plot: run-balanced attack quantile bins; y normalized by each run's P99 non-epoch calibration threshold for cross-run comparability
support_score_primary_statistic: within-run Spearman rho between scaled extrapolation distance and common non-epoch reconstruction score s_q
